verse.verse_1: Nun By the pen and by that which they inscribe.
verse.verse_2: Thou art nor, through the grace of thy Lord, mad.
verse.verse_3: And verily thine shall be a hire unending."
verse.verse_4: And verily thou art of a high and noble disposition.
verse.verse_5: Anon thou wilt see and they will see:
verse.verse_6: Which of you is afflicted with madness.
verse.verse_7: Verily thy Lord! He is the best Knower of him who strayeth from His path, and He is the best Knower of the guided one,
verse.verse_8: Wherefore obey not thou the beliers.
verse.verse_9: Fain would they that thou shouldst be pliant, so that they will be pliant.
verse.verse_10: And obey not: thou any swearer ignominous.
verse.verse_11: A defamer, spreader abroad of slander.
verse.verse_12: Hinderer of the good, trespasser; sinner.
verse.verse_14: Because he is owner of riches and children.
verse.verse_15: When Our revelations are rehearsed Unto him, he saith: fables of the ancients.
verse.verse_16: Anon We shall brand him on snout.
verse.verse_17: Verily We! We have proved them even as We proved the fellows of a garden when they swarethat they would surely reap it in the morning.
verse.verse_18: And they made not the exception.
verse.verse_19: Wherefore an encircling visitation visited it even as they slept on.
verse.verse_20: Then in the morning it became as though it had been reaped.
verse.verse_21: Then they cried out Unto each other in the morning,
verse.verse_22: Saying: go out betimes to your tilth if ye would reap.
verse.verse_23: So they went off speaking to each other in a low voice:
verse.verse_24: Let there not enter upon you today any needy man.
verse.verse_25: And they went out betimes determined in purpose.
verse.verse_26: Then when they beheld it, they said: verily we have strayed.
verse.verse_27: Aye! it is we who are deprived!
verse.verse_28: The most moderate of them said: said I not Unto you, wherefore hallow him ye not!
verse.verse_29: They said: hallowed be Our Lord! verily we have been wrong- doers.
verse.verse_30: Then they turned to each other reproaching
verse.verse_31: They said: woe Unto us! verily we! we have been arrogant.
verse.verse_32: Belike our Lord may exchange for us better garden than this; verily we are Unto our Lord beseechers.
verse.verse_33: Such is the torment. And the torment of the Hereafter is far greater; if they but knew.
verse.verse_34: Verily for the God-fearing, are with their Lord Gardens of Delight.
verse.verse_35: Shall We then make the Muslims like the culprits?
verse.verse_36: What aileth you? How ill ye judge!
verse.verse_37: Is there with you a Book wherein ye study:
verse.verse_38: That therein is yours that which. ye may choose?
verse.verse_39: Or have ye oaths from us reaching to the Day of Resurrection, that you shall be that which ye judge?
verse.verse_40: Ask then, which of them will stand thereof a surety?
verse.verse_41: Have they associate gods? Then let them produce their associate gods if they say sooth!
verse.verse_42: Remember the Day whereon the shank shall be bared and they shall be called upon to Prostrate themselves, but they shall not be able.
verse.verse_43: Downcast will be their looks; abjectness will overspread them. Surely they had been called upon to Prostrate themselves while yet they were whole.
verse.verse_44: Let Me alone with him who belieth this discourse; step by step We lead them on when they perceive not.
verse.verse_45: And I bear with them; verily My contrivance is sure.
verse.verse_46: Askest thou a hire from them so that they are laden with debt?
verse.verse_47: Is with them the unseen, so that they write down?
verse.verse_48: Be patient thou, then, with thy Lord's judgment, and be thou not like him of the fish, when he cried out while he was in anguish.
verse.verse_49: Had not grace from his Lord reached him, he had surely been cast into the wilderness in a plight.
verse.verse_50: Then his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
verse.verse_51: And those who disbelieve well-nigh cause thee to stumble with their looks when they hear the Admonition, and they say: verily he is mad.
verse.verse_52: While it is naught but an admonition Unto the worlds.
